sample_data.method: Import data accepts either the published multi-case JSON wrapper or one individual case, then loads the selected case through the Worker API.
sample_data.reset_instructions: Open Import data and choose Reset to demo data to restore the 46-medicine demonstration stock list.

problem_solving_method: The team separated expiry calculations from presentation, computes each medicine's status and value from an explicit effective date, and keeps returned stock outside every active count and value. A Hono Worker and D1 provide the stock API while React renders the operational dashboard, import workflow, reports, and responsive interface.

R1.evidence: Stock page; backend/seed.sql; backend/src/lib/demoData.ts; GET /api/medicines. The resettable demonstration data contains 46 medicines with name, batch, quantity, unit purchase price, and expiry date.

R2.evidence: Overview page; backend/src/lib/grouping.ts; GET /api/dashboard. Active stock is grouped into expired, 0-30 days inclusive, 31-90 days, and safe using the current or imported effective date.

R3.evidence: Stock and Returned pages; POST /api/medicines/:id/return and /unreturn. Returned items leave active counts and values and can be restored.

R4.evidence: Overview risk banner and dashboard group values; backend/src/index.ts. Value at risk is expired value plus the 0-30-day group, with each item valued as quantity multiplied by unit_price_bdt.

team_members.major_contribution: Team lead; coordinated the two-project submission, preserved the P02 history under the submitting account, audited live-guide compliance, and finalized judging documentation.
Primary P02 engineer; implemented the Hono and D1 backend, expiry and risk calculations, returned-stock workflow, React dashboard, data import, reporting, responsive UI, and Cloudflare deployments.

major_design_decisions: Compute expiry groups from an effective date on every request instead of storing a status that can become stale.
Treat returned stock as explicit state and exclude it from every active count and value while allowing undo.
Use quantity multiplied by unit purchase price for all taka values and define value at risk as expired plus the 0-30-day group.
Keep the React frontend and Hono/D1 backend separately deployable while exposing typed API helpers in the client.
Let judges import the published multi-case wrapper, select one case, and reset the database to deterministic demo data.
known_limitations: The API has no authentication; import and demo reset replace the shared stock data for every visitor.
The backend permits cross-origin requests from any origin.
The repository has no committed automated test suite; verification relies on TypeScript and production builds, direct API probes, and manual fixture imports.
The production frontend and API remain deployed in the original contributor's Cloudflare account.
